title: VANISHED | 19 Minutes: The Disappearance of Maura Murray
description:
February 9, 2004. A black car hits a snowbank on Route 112 in New Hampshire. A school bus driver stops to help. Nineteen minutes later, police arrive, and 21-year-old Maura Murray is gone. More than twenty years later, no trace of her has ever been found.

The fake email, the cash, the packed room, the scent that ended at the road, and the three main theories.

If you have any information, contact the New Hampshire State Police.

New real mystery every Wednesday and Saturday.

#mauramurray #unsolvedmysteries #truecrime #missingperson
comment: She told the bus driver she had called AAA. What do you think happened in those 19 minutes?
